name: b6406-feather
prompt: Cinematic vertical 9:16 photoreal, 7th-century Arabia, bright clear morning in a green oasis. Close shot of one anonymous open RIGHT hand, palm up, and a single small soft white feather floating down through the air just above the palm, about to land on it. Only the right hand and forearm in a plain undyed period sleeve are visible - no faces, no heads, no second hand. Behind: softly blurred vivid green date palms and a deep blue sky with white clouds. Even daylight from above, the sun out of frame, vibrant saturated colours, light and airy, no modern objects.
